summary: Integer stepper whose number rolls over a dotted wash; holding a button repeats faster, and stepping past a limit shakes and flashes red.

attributes.name: value
attributes.description: Current value, rounded and clamped to `min`–`max`. Observed: a change rolls to the new number without firing events. Reflects the current value.

attributes.name: min
attributes.description: Lowest allowed value. Observed: a change re-clamps the value.

attributes.name: max
attributes.description: Highest allowed value. Observed: a change re-clamps the value.

attributes.name: label
attributes.description: Visible label, associated with the number field. Observed.

attributes.name: price
attributes.description: Unit price. When set, the line below reads `<value> × <currency><price> = <currency><total> / month`. Observed.

attributes.name: unit
attributes.description: Text shown below the stepper when `price` is not set. Observed.

attributes.name: name
attributes.description: Form field name used when the element is inside a form.

attributes.name: disabled
attributes.description: Presence attribute. Disables the field and buttons; a disabled ancestor `<fieldset>` does the same.

events.name: input
events.description: Fires on each change from the buttons, keys or typed entry. Not fired when `value` is set from code.

events.name: change
events.description: Fires 300 ms after the last `input`, so holding a button produces one `change`.

properties.name: value
properties.description: Current value. Setting it writes the `value` attribute; no events fire.

properties.name: name
properties.description: The `name` attribute. There is no setter; set the attribute instead.

keyboard.action: In the number field: add or subtract 1.
In the number field: add or subtract 10. If that would pass `min` or `max`, the value stays and the field flashes red.
In the number field: commit the typed number and leave the field.
On the − or + button: step by 1. At `min` or `max` the field shakes and flashes red instead.

accessibility: The number is an `<input>` with `role="spinbutton"`, `inputmode="numeric"`, `aria-valuenow`, `aria-valuemin` and `aria-valuemax`, named by the visible label.
The − and + buttons have `aria-label` `Decrease` and `Increase`. At a limit they get `aria-disabled="true"` but stay focusable, so focus is not lost.
A visually hidden `aria-live="polite"` region announces the label, the value and the price or unit line 300 ms after the value settles, so holding a button gives one announcement.

The visible number is text marked `aria-hidden`, because the spinbutton already exposes the value; while the input has focus, its own text replaces it. The wash and sparks are on an `aria-hidden` canvas.
motion: With reduced motion, the number and the line below change without rolling, and the scan line, shake and sparks are skipped; the red flash and heat tint remain.
form: Submits the integer as a string under `name`. There is no validation. Form reset restores the value from the first connect; `disabled` or a disabled fieldset disables the field and buttons.
notes: Holding − or + repeats after 420 ms, speeding up from 160 ms to 35 ms per step, and stops at `min` or `max`. While a button is held, the number and the line below swap without rolling.
Clicking the number focuses the field for typing. The typed text is parsed as an integer and clamped when the field loses focus.
Changes to `value` from code, through the attribute or the property, roll the number but fire no events.
While typing, the inner field's native `input` events stay inside the shadow root; only the element's own `input` and `change` events, with `value` in `detail`, reach the host.
The host is `inline-block`; the buttons and number area are 40px tall. The number is set in the mono font with tabular figures.
